metadata.title: dev_tool
metadata.description: Test harness for the HTTP-triggered building-block model. Calls CLOPSSEC_ticket_creation the way a live caller does — an HTTPS POST to the block's own Request trigger, no nested-workflow shortcut — then walks the new ticket to Closed through CLOPSSEC_ticket_transition along TransitionPath (for each entry: list the transitions, pick the one leading to that status or carrying that name, fill its required fields, transition), records the status code and response contract of every call and answers with the report. Overwrites the existing dev_tool Logic App in place; no API connections are created.
prerequisites: CLOPSSEC_ticket_creation deployed in the same resource group BEFORE this template, with a Request trigger named 'manual' (the template reads its callback URL with listCallbackUrl and fails if it is missing).
The CLOPSSEC_ticket_transition trigger URL passed as TicketTransitionUrl; the default is a placeholder, and with it every run that walks the ticket answers 400 before any ticket is raised.

CLOPSSEC_ticket_transition's own system-assigned identity has a Key Vault access policy (secret get) on LSY-WEUR-ITCS-PRD-KV-02; without it every close-stage call answers 500 and the harness reports fail.
The deploying principal can list the ticket-creation playbook's trigger callback URL (Logic App Contributor on the RG is enough).
metadata.author: dev_tool

metadata.description: Name of the existing Consumption Logic App to overwrite. Always pass explicitly.
Building block that raises the CLOPSSEC ticket. Its 'manual' trigger callback URL is read at deploy time and stored as a secure workflow parameter.

HTTPS trigger callback URL (SAS included) of the CLOPSSEC_ticket_transition building block, stored as a secure workflow parameter. The default is a placeholder: until it is replaced every run with the close stage on answers 400 before any ticket is raised (close_ticket: false still tests the creation block alone). Pass the real URL at deploy time; never commit it.
Trackspace base URL, used only to build browse links in the report.
issue_type sent to the ticket-creation block when the request carries none. Incident, because the sentinelsvc account is not allowed to create Task in CLOPSSEC.
Priority sent to the ticket-creation block when the request carries none: a Jira priority name or numeric id. 10114 is the lowest CLOPSSEC priority, so test tickets never raise a Critical Incident.
Ticket summary when the request carries none.

DefaultDescription.defaultValue: Automated test ticket raised by the dev_tool Logic App to validate the CLOPSSEC_ticket_creation -> CLOPSSEC_ticket_transition building-block chain. Safe to close.

metadata.description: Ticket description when the request carries none.
Walk the test ticket along TransitionPath after creating it (request override: close_ticket). false leaves it open.

Every step the ticket is walked through, in order, one name per step (request override: transition_path). Each entry is a target status name or a transition name, case-insensitive: a transition leading to that status is taken first, else a transition with that name; an entry naming the status the ticket is already in is passed without a call. List every status/transition up to Closed. CLOPSSEC Incident workflow: Open -> In Progress -> Resolved -> Closed.

Values for required transition fields, keyed by Jira field id or display name, e.g. {"resolution": "Done"} (request override: transition_field_values). Without one the first allowed value Jira lists is used, unless Jira has a default for the field.

Runaway guard on the run length, counted from the start of the run: no transition is submitted after this many seconds and no list call is started after this minus 6 s. dev_tool answers asynchronously (202 + Location), so this is not tied to the 120-second synchronous window; a healthy default run takes about 1 minute (unmeasured).

issue_type.description: Task | Problem | Incident (default: parameter DefaultIssueType = Incident). Sent to the ticket-creation block.

priority.description: Jira priority name or numeric id (default: parameter DefaultPriority = 10114, the lowest)

close_ticket.description: true (default: parameter CloseTicket = true): after creating it, walk the ticket along transition_path through the transition block. false: skip the close stage; the ticket stays open.

transition_path.description: What the ticket is walked through, in order, one entry per step (case-insensitive; default: parameter TransitionPath = ["In Progress","Resolved","Closed"]). Each entry is a target status name or a transition name: a transition leading to that status is taken first, else a transition with that name. An entry naming the status the ticket is already in is passed without a call.

transition_field_values.description: Values for REQUIRED transition fields, keyed by Jira field id (e.g. resolution) or display name (e.g. Resolution); default: parameter TransitionFieldValues = {}. A required field with no value here gets the first allowed value Jira lists for it, unless Jira has a default for it; one without allowed values is left out and the block answers 400 (missing field).

targets.description: Per-run overrides of the building blocks under test. Omit to use the stored URLs (ticket creation: read at deploy time; ticket transition: parameter TicketTransitionUrl). Override both when pointing a run at INT.

ticket_creation_url.description: HTTPS trigger callback URL of the ticket-creation block, SAS query string included.

ticket_transition_url.description: HTTPS trigger callback URL of the ticket-transition block, SAS query string included. Only checked when the close stage runs. Required when ticket_creation_url is overridden and the close stage runs.
